as_written: DEATH NOTICE, pursuant to the provisions contained in "The Administration of Estates Act, 1913"
note: Printed form, E.W. (Pty) Ltd. Annotated at the head 1847/50 and 28-4-1950.
Not Pablo Armando. The Cape buried him under the English name.
*** NATIONALITY ONLY. No town, no province. The notice does not say Rosario. ***
*** THE ANSWER, AND IT IS A NULL. ***
*** THE ANSWER, AND IT IS A NULL. ***

*** A TEN-YEAR DISCREPANCY, AND IT IS NOT SMOOTHED. *** His passport and his enrolment card both give 22 February 1882, which makes him 68 at death. This says 77, and the informant wrote "approx" beside it in her own hand. She did not know his parents' names either. It is an estimate by a woman who was not his family, and the archive keeps 1882 - but it records the 77.
Agrees with the 1940 passport. Thirty-nine years after "horse-dealer" on the marriage register.
*** NONE. He did not marry Rose Lilian Theys, whatever the family believed. ***

as_written: *** Mary Septima Lerena born Taylor - died in 1935 ***
note: Agrees with 15 November 1935.
Agrees with Wynberg, 3 September 1911.

as_written: House No. 7 Forth Road, Newlands, District Cape
note: *** The same address as the executrix in the liquidation account. ***

as_written: *** Roque Luis Armando Lerena; Ricardo Juan Carlos Lerena; Nuno Fernando Lerena - all majors ***
note: Three sons, no daughters. Agrees with the 1950 liquidation account.
He had no children by any other marriage - so Careen Maria Lerena, the 1947 infant in his grave, is not acknowledged here.
Dated 6 February 1942, per the liquidation account.
Rose Lilian Theys
She was in the room when he died. In the liquidation account she is described as a spinster of No. 7 Forth Road - the same house - and "no relation".
*** LERINA on the civil register - the spelling this archive has treated as a clerk's slip, and here it is on the death certificate itself. ***
Against "77 approx" on the notice and against 68 implied by the passport's 22 February 1882.
Vaguer even than the notice's "Argentine". No country, no town.
The notice says Racehorse Trainer; the passport says Trainer; the 1911 marriage says horse-dealer.

as_written: *** Coronary Thrombosis; Angina Pectoris. Duration: 6 weeks; about 3 years. ***
note: *** A cause of death this archive did not have. *** His son Nuno died of a coronary thrombosis at forty-six, twenty-one years later.
The same Dr J. R. E. Lee whose bill for professional services appears in the 1950 liquidation account.

*** THIS CONTRADICTS THE FAMILY. *** Cheryl was told by the Newlands cemetery office that he, Mary Septima and an infant lie there. The certificate names MAITLAND as the intended place of burial. Intended is not actual - but one of the two is wrong and neither has been checked against a burial register.

as_written: *** W. Fraser, of Main Road, Observatory. Qualification: "Causing burial". ***
note: *** AN UNDERTAKER. *** So the death notice was completed by a woman of no relation and the death certificate by the undertaker. *** Not one document at his death was filled in by anybody who knew where he came from. ***

as_written: 23.3.50 Woodstock (W. Juritz); 25.3.50 Wynberg (M.F.G. Jones); extracted 19 April 1950, Cape Town
